text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Come now, do not be so disheartened.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No need. It is hardly something one can 
master 
so easily on a sudden whim.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
In all things, gaining experience is 
essential. 
Let us simply await the next opportunity.
